name: Black Currant Tri Cone
ingredients: Ice Cream (73%): Milk solids, sugar, emulsifler (471), stabilizers (407, 466, 415, 412), artificial flavouring substances (black currant, fonovin), colours (102, 122, 132); Wafer Biscuit (14%); Refined wheat flour, sugar, coconut oil, emulsifier (322), Topping and Spray (13%): Cocoa solids, sugar, cocoa butter, coconut oil, black currant fruit pieces (2.5%), emulsifier (322). Allergen Information. Contains milk, wheat.
